# SenselessTernaryOperator

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" /> 

Group: [Confusing constructs](/rules/#confusing-constructs) · PhpStorm name: `SenselessTernaryOperatorInspection`

`$a === $b ? $a : $b` always evaluates to `$b`: when the two are identical it
does not matter which one is returned. The same holds for `!==` with swapped
branches. Such ternaries only add branching; replace them with the operand
that is always the result.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{2,3,4,5,6,7} [Before]
<?php
$a = $left === $right ? $left : $right;
$b = $left !== $right ? $left : $right;
$c = $size === -1 ? -1 : $size;
$d = ($ref === null) ? $ref : null;
$e = $t !== 'n/a' ? $t : 'n/a';
$f = f($ratio !== 1.5 ? 1.5 : $ratio);
$g = $left == $right ? $left : $right;
$h = $left === $right ?: $right;
$i = $left === $right ? ($left) : $right;
$j = $left === $right ? $left : $other;
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
$a = $right;
$b = $left;
$c = $size;
$d = null;
$e = $t;
$f = f(1.5);
$g = $left == $right ? $left : $right;
$h = $left === $right ?: $right;
$i = $left === $right ? ($left) : $right;
$j = $left === $right ? $left : $other;
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 2: This ternary always yields &#39;$right&#39;; use it directly.</li>
<li>line 3: This ternary always yields &#39;$left&#39;; use it directly.</li>
<li>line 4: This ternary always yields &#39;$size&#39;; use it directly.</li>
<li>line 5: This ternary always yields &#39;null&#39;; use it directly.</li>
<li>line 6: This ternary always yields &#39;$t&#39;; use it directly.</li>
<li>line 7: This ternary always yields &#39;1.5&#39;; use it directly.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "SenselessTernaryOperator": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore SenselessTernaryOperator

/**
 * @noinspection SenselessTernaryOperatorInspection
 */
```
